title: Multimodal Approach Feasability Study for Untreated and Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysms
official: Proof of Concept Study to Evaluate the Feasibility of a Multimodal Approach Combining Angiography and 3D Ultrasound for the Hemodynamic Analysis of Unruptured, Untreated Intracranial Aneurysms
summary: This feasibility study aims to evaluate the SYLVER system's ability to visualize intracranial aneurysms in accordance with 3D rotational angiography (3DRA) as the reference technique.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients (≥ 18 years of age)
* Informed consent signed by the patient
* Enrolled in a social security program or covered by an equivalent program
* Presence of one or more unruptured, untreated intracranial aneurysms; typically bifurcation aneurysms, incidentally discovered, with a size of ≥ 3 mm; located at the base of the polygon of Willis in the Sylvian bifurcation, the anterior or posterior communicating artery, or the carotid or basilar terminal segments
* Indications for diagnostic cerebral arteriography within a 6-month period following the discovery of one or more unruptured aneurysms

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unusable temporal window
* Withdrawal of Consent by the Patient
* Cancellation of the appointment for a cerebral angiography
* At the investigator's initiative, in the patient's best interest
